Vector-specific estimated entomological parameters

Source: R/data_doc.R
vec_ent_param.Rd

Bionomic parameterisations for 57 Anopheles species, 17 complexes and the genus, from the AnophelesBionomics package (https://github.com/SwissTPH/AnophelesBionomics; "Estimating mosquito bionomics parameters with a hierarchical Bayesian model", Current Research in Parasitology & Vector-Borne Diseases, 2026). Each parameter is estimated with a hierarchical Bayesian model (genus, complex, species) from published field data; the values are posterior means and standard deviations.

Taxa are identified by species_name and level. Complexes are named by their label (e.g. "Gambiae"; "Funestus" is a group). A species alone in its complex is listed once, as a species (no complex row). An. gambiae s.s. and An. coluzzii are merged as "Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii". Taxa without data for a parameter carry the value imputed from their complex or the genus, flagged in imputed_traits. An. freeborni and An. nivipes have no parent complex in the AnophelesBionomics taxonomy.

The dataset is regenerated with data-raw/vec_ent_param_from_AnophelesBionomics.R (from the AnophelesBionomics posterior draws) and data-raw/vec_ent_param.R; its provenance is stored in attr(vec_ent_param, "source").

Usage

vec_ent_param

Format

A data frame with the following columns:

  • species_name: name of the taxon

  • level: "species", "complex" or "genus"

  • complex: parent complex of a species; NA for complexes, the genus, species alone in their complex and species without a complex

  • imputed_traits: parameters without data for this taxon, separated by ";" (empty if all are estimated from its own data)

  • M, M.sd: parous rate (proportion of host-seeking mosquitoes that have laid eggs at least once)

  • Chi, Chi.sd: human blood index used by the model (proportion of blood meals taken on humans); by default the indoor human blood index (see hbi in def_vector_params)

  • HBI_indoor, HBI_indoor.sd, HBI_outdoor, HBI_outdoor.sd: indoor and outdoor human blood indices

  • A0, A0.sd: sac rate (proportion of mosquitoes who laid eggs the same day)

  • zeta.3: relative availability of different non-human hosts (fixed to 1)

  • td: proportion of a day that a mosquito actively seeks a host (fixed to 0.33)

  • tau, tau.sd: resting duration (days), time required for a mosquito that has encountered a host to return to host-seeking. Estimated as \(1/q\), with \(q = fed / (fed + gravid)\) the proportion of fed females among fed and gravid females in field resting collections (i.e. assuming a one-day fed stage). This may underestimate the resting duration if gravid females are under-sampled indoors or if digestion lasts more than a day. Rounded to whole days in the survival over the extrinsic incubation period.

  • ts: duration of the extrinsic incubation period (fixed to 10)

  • to: oocyst development time (fixed to 5)

  • endophily, endophily.sd: proportion of indoor resting mosquitoes

  • endophagy, endophagy.sd: proportion of indoor feeding mosquitoes

Value

vector-specific entomological parameters

See also

def_vector_params, list_all_species, read_bionomics_table

Author
